reason: I already order kids' things through the Erbil company I use and it has mostly worked fine, so I don't see why I'd switch to a new name. 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 pair of shoes is a lot when I can walk Shorja and find something close for less.
objection: My current service is already cheap enough and I know how it works; a new company has to prove itself first, and two to three weeks is long when my kids need something now.
would_change_my_mind: If a relative or neighbour I trust used them and showed me the final cost was clearly lower than my usual page for the same item, I'd try the free cash-on-delivery first order.
